memories.text: Old shopping list: batteries, brown rice, a birthday candle shaped like a question mark.
The kitchen window whistles when the wind comes from the east. A folded towel helps for now.
Grandma's pancake rule: stop stirring while the batter still looks a little lumpy.
First five-kilometer walk without stopping. The hill behind the library still felt unfair.
Comprar limones, jabón y una libreta pequeña. La última terminó llena de recetas.
Picked up the repaired shoes after work. Ask for the softer heel pads next time.
Nora brought cherries and stayed until the rain stopped. We never actually played cards.
Train picnic: cheese sandwiches, cucumber, peaches. Bring napkins; newspaper is a terrible substitute.
Copied from the old notebook: measure the doorway before buying any more furniture.
La albahaca necesita menos agua de la que le estoy dando. Hay que dejar secar la tierra.
Finished the mystery with the missing violin. Guessed the culprit, completely missed the motive.
A long work call meant dinner was toast and scrambled eggs. Keep frozen peas for evenings like this.
Old address-book scrap: Uncle Hugo likes postcards more than birthday cards.
Dentist appointment moved to Thursday at 9:20. Bring the night guard.
La bufanda azul está en la caja de los manteles, por alguna razón.
Put a small amount into the holiday fund each payday. Even enough for train tickets would help.
Dad laughed so hard at the paper crown that his glasses fell into his lap.
Old pocket diary: buy milk after work; return the borrowed umbrella; remember that Thursday is bin day.
The bathroom tap needs a new washer. Photograph the fitting before going to the hardware shop.
Probé lentejas con comino y zanahoria. Mejor al día siguiente, con un poco de limón.
Sara's baby gripped my finger and refused to let go. Everything else could wait ten minutes.
Library hold arrived. Collect by Saturday, preferably before the market gets crowded.
Borrow a tent before buying one. I may like the idea of camping more than the damp reality.
From an old receipt: work lunch cost more than the paperback I bought afterward. Pack lunch tomorrow.
La playa estaba vacía a las ocho. Solo había un perro persiguiendo espuma y un señor con una radio.
Bike lock code hint: the year of the terrible school haircut. Don't write the actual numbers here.
Bought a secondhand camera. The battery compartment sticks, but the afternoon photos came out beautifully.
Eye test booked for next month. Bring both pairs of glasses, including the scratched ones.
Try roasting grapes with thyme. Sounds unlikely; tasted excellent at dinner with Mateo.
Después del trabajo fui andando a casa. El paseo me quitó de la cabeza una conversación pesada.
Emergency candle box is missing matches. A very organized collection of useless wax.
Recipe card from an older folder: orange cake needs the zest of two oranges, juice of one.
My cousin Pilar is a nurse at a hospital in Leeds. Send something edible for her birthday.
No elaborate resolutions. More walks, fewer unopened letters, learn one good soup.
La puerta del armario vuelve a rozar. Revisar la bisagra de arriba antes de lijar nada.
Packed soup for work and forgot the spoon. Put a spare in the bag permanently.
The dentist said to keep an eye on the sensitive tooth. Cold water still catches it.
Idea for a rainy Sunday: photograph every red door within walking distance.
Imported from the old phone: Mum's preferred tea is the plain breakfast blend, never the perfumed one.
Inés me prestó una novela y me pidió que no leyera la contraportada. Tenía razón.
The small suitcase fits overhead if I leave the outside pocket empty.
Went swimming before work. The hardest part was leaving the warm changing room afterward.
Tomás taught me a knot for securing the tomato plants. Draw it before I forget.
Rain came through the bedroom window frame. Took photos and put a bowl beneath the corner.
Guardar monedas para la lavandería. La máquina no acepta billetes aunque el cartel diga que sí.
At the museum, a child asked whether the statues got tired. Best question of the afternoon.
Soup attempt three: fewer potatoes, more leek, blend only half. Finally tastes like something.
Work ran late, but I still caught the last half of the choir rehearsal. Glad I went.
Cancel the magazine subscription before it renews. The unread stack is becoming furniture.
Papá guardó todas las etiquetas de los regalos para hacer un collage. Nadie sabe si habla en serio.
Found the missing earring inside a winter boot. There is probably a story, but I don't know it.
Boiler service booked for the 22nd, morning slot. Clear the cupboard underneath.
Practice guitar changes slowly enough that every string rings. Speed can wait.
Bought tulips on the way home from work. They lean toward the window by lunchtime.
Llamar a la abuela el domingo por la mañana. Por la tarde suele estar jugando a las cartas.
Walking boots rub the left heel. Try thicker socks before replacing them.
Lisbon notes: steep streets, excellent custard tarts, laundry fluttering above tiny balconies. Take fewer clothes next time.
The homemade jam set too firmly. Calling it strawberry spread feels optimistic.
Nora wants a quiet birthday: noodles, a walk, no surprise guests.
Llevé fruta para la pausa del trabajo y acabé comiéndola en el autobús. Preparar algo más para mañana.
Keep receipts for the broken toaster until the refund arrives.
Signed up for six pottery evenings. First bowl resembles a tired hat, but it holds water.
A sentence I want to remember: 'You can begin with the part you understand.' Heard it from Eva.
Flu jab booked. Wear a sleeve that rolls up easily.
La receta de galletas necesita una pizca de sal. Sin ella saben demasiado dulces y un poco planas.
After a tense workday, sanding the little stool felt surprisingly calming. Still need to oil the legs.
Gift ideas: puzzle for Dad, gardening gloves for Mum, concert tickets to share with Sara.
Walked home under a clear sky. Could see my breath all the way to the front door.
The bank fee was reversed after one phone call. Check statements more often.
He dejado las pilas usadas en una bolsa junto a la puerta. Llevarlas al punto de recogida.
My knee complained after the long downhill stretch. Book a physiotherapy appointment if it keeps happening.
Remember to take the parcel before work tomorrow. It has spent three days beside the door.
The seedlings all bent toward the same corner. Rotate the tray every few days.
Camping was wet. The stove worked. The socks did not dry. Somehow I want to go again.
Mateo hace la tortilla con la cebolla muy lenta, casi una hora. No intentar acelerar ese paso.
Renew passport before booking anything overseas. Check how many blank pages remain too.
Saw a kingfisher by the canal: one flash of blue, then ordinary water again.
Work was busy enough that I forgot lunch. Keep crackers and nuts in the bag.
The book group spent forty minutes discussing the cover and ten discussing the book.
Comprar una bombilla cálida para la lámpara del sofá. La actual parece de sala de espera.
Replace the smoke alarm battery this weekend. The spare is in the drawer with the tape.
Hugo showed me photos of his first motorbike. His expression hasn't changed in forty years.
Make a simple list of regular bills and renewal months. Paper tucked into random envelopes isn't a system.
Met Inés after work for hot chocolate. We both ordered cake and pretended it counted as dinner.
Este año quiero imprimir algunas fotos. Tenerlas todas en el teléfono hace que nunca las mire.
Freezer inventory: two portions of chili, mystery broth, peas, one heroic slice of birthday cake.
The optician adjusted the frames. Such a small change; no more sliding down my nose.
Try a Sunday without buying anything. Library, leftovers, long walk, whatever is already here.
Found a decent route to the station that avoids the noisy junction. Five minutes longer, much nicer.
Una llamada de trabajo se alargó y perdí el autobús. El siguiente iba casi vacío; pude leer sentada.
Sara's little boy calls all birds 'ducks.' Today that included an enormous pigeon.
Lemon dressing: three spoons oil, one spoon juice, mustard, salt. Shake in the jam jar.
Booked the early ferry. Leave room for breakfast instead of sprinting aboard hungry.
The bathroom grout is cracking near the shower tray. Get someone to look before it becomes a leak.
Me gustó dibujar la misma taza durante una semana. Cada día parecía un objeto distinto.
Put the knitting in my bag for the journey after work. Three rows are better than none.
Aunt Rosa's apple cake uses yogurt, not milk. Her handwritten recipe has a suspiciously vague oven temperature.
The pharmacy closes earlier on Saturdays. Stop assuming every shop keeps supermarket hours.
First proper frost. The spiderweb on the gate looked like a tiny necklace.
Revisar el seguro de casa antes de renovarlo. Comparar la cobertura, no solo la cuota.
Nora gave me a notebook with thick paper. Save it for drawings, but actually use it.
Checked one work message during the holiday and lost half an hour thinking about it. Leave notifications off tomorrow.
The soup pot lid is behind the baking trays. Writing this down because apparently I need to.
Blood test on Tuesday morning. Read the appointment letter again for preparation instructions.
La vecina me dio esquejes de geranio. Dejar las macetas pequeñas en el alféizar más luminoso.
Learned to mend a tiny hole in a jumper. The patch shows, but I like it.
Edinburgh packing: waterproof jacket, comfortable shoes, spare camera battery, no hardback books.
Listened to an entire album while cooking after work. Better than letting three videos play over each other.
Dad wants help sorting the shed. Start with one shelf so neither of us gives up immediately.
El gazpacho quedó demasiado espeso. Añadir agua fría poco a poco antes de servir.
The cheap picnic blanket lets damp grass through. Bring the waterproof sheet underneath.
New library card finally works. Borrowed a book about moths and another about bread.
Physio exercises are easier to remember beside the kettle. Put the printed sheet there.
Had a quiet lunch break at work and wrote a proper letter to Grandma. Buy stamps on Saturday.
Idea: guardar una receta de cada persona de la familia, con sus comentarios y manchas originales.
The hallway paint looks green at night and gray in daylight. Test a bigger patch before deciding.
Put the unexpected refund toward the emergency fund. It doesn't need to become an unexpected purchase.
Forgot how much I enjoy singing with other people. Even the warm-up scales made me cheerful.
Mum found the old holiday slides. Borrow a scanner before the labels fade any further.
Antes del trabajo pasé por la panadería. Todavía estaba caliente el pan cuando llegué a desayunar.
Shoemaker says the boots have another winter in them. Collect Friday; ticket in wallet.
Inés recommended a novel told through letters. Ask her for the title; I only remember the yellow cover.
Repotted the fern. It had more roots than soil and probably deserved an apology.
The swimming pool is quietest just after opening on Sundays. Check holiday hours first.
Mi sobrino inventó una palabra para el olor de la lluvia: «mojadulce». Me parece bastante precisa.
Took the scenic route home after work and found a tiny secondhand bookshop. Return when there's time to browse.
Holiday apartment has a washing machine. Pack half as many shirts and a little detergent.
Peaches on toast with soft cheese and black pepper. Summer lunch requiring almost no effort.
Check whether the dripping sound is the gutter or the overflow pipe next time it rains.
He devuelto los libros, pero la bolsa de tela se quedó en casa de Sara.
Set a reminder for the annual railcard renewal. Last year's lapse cost two full-price tickets.
A difficult work conversation went better after I wrote down the actual question. Useful beyond work, probably.
The green scarf is finished. One end is wider, so that end gets tucked inside the coat.
Grandma's phrase today: 'A visit doesn't need an occasion.' Put a Sunday aside.
Comprar entradas para el concierto de febrero. A Nora le gustan los asientos del pasillo.
Made stock from the leftover vegetables. Label the container before it becomes another frozen mystery.
Hearing test booked for the 30th. Mention the ringing after loud concerts.
Forgot my lunch at home before work. The soup was still waiting patiently when I returned.
Called Mum instead of sending another short message. She mostly wanted to describe the birds in the garden.
Hoy hice pan por primera vez. Quedó duro por fuera y algo crudo por dentro. La mantequilla ayudó. Probar otra vez el sábado.
Counted seven different birds from the kitchen window. Need a better guide for the small brown ones.
Online book club worked better with six people than twelve. Everyone actually got to speak.
The basil cutting has roots. Apparently one glass of water can become a small victory.
After work, walked until I stopped rehearsing tomorrow's tasks. Came home hungry and much easier to live with.
Arreglar el pinchazo de la bici antes del domingo. El parche anterior aguantó casi tres años.
Monthly spending is lower without all the little impulse stops. Move some of the difference into savings.
Tried drawing my own hand. It looks like five carrots attached to a mitten.
The doctor asked me to keep a headache diary: date, duration, sleep, anything unusual.
Roast squash seeds with salt and smoked paprika. Check early; they burn while I'm feeling confident.
La reunión de trabajo acabó pronto y pude llamar a la abuela antes de su siesta.
Buy a warmer reading lamp bulb. Winter evenings need something kinder than the ceiling light.
Posted small parcels to three friends. Forgot how satisfying it is to wrap a book.
We opened presents on a video call. Dad kept pointing the camera at the ceiling. Everyone shouted instructions. We laughed anyway.
Cleaned out the medicine drawer. Check the pharmacy's instructions for returning expired items.
Quiero aprender a reconocer los árboles sin hojas. Empezar por los tres del parque de siempre.
Tea went cold during a work call again. Use the insulated mug already sitting in the cupboard.
The landlord arranged a plumber for Monday afternoon. Clear everything from under the sink.
First outdoor lunch with Sara in months. Wind stole a napkin; we stayed for two hours.
The strawberries need netting before the birds discover the ripe ones. They are better at checking than I am.
Para la ensalada de garbanzos: pepino, perejil, limón, aceite y cebolla muy fina. Llevar el aliño aparte.
Downloaded the walking map before leaving. Signal vanished exactly where the paths forked.
A work deadline made the week feel endless. Saturday's only plan is the river path and a sandwich.
New running shoes feel good on short walks. Build up gradually instead of testing them on a huge loop.
Found Grandpa's handwriting inside a cookbook: 'More onions.' That could have been his advice for almost anything.
La cita del dentista es a las diez y cuarto, no a las diez. Lo he comprobado dos veces.
Try repairing the chair with proper clamps. Balancing a stack of books on it did not count.
Finished a collection of essays slowly, one each morning. Nice to let a book last.
Picked up wool after work. The shopkeeper found a nearly matching green for the unfinished scarf.
Ask each person to bring one side dish. Hosting dinner doesn't require cooking every single thing.
Guardé las luces sin enredarlas. Dentro de un año seguramente no me lo creeré.
Set aside money for replacing the washing machine. It has started sounding like a departing helicopter.
Mum's birthday lunch: reserve somewhere with comfortable chairs and room to hear each other.
Try growing radishes. The seed packet promises speed, which may suit my gardening patience.
Work started later today, so I had breakfast on the balcony. Ten quiet minutes changed the whole morning.
El tren de vuelta sale de otra estación. Revisar el billete antes de seguir a la multitud.
Saw the sea after a long walk through pine trees. Stayed until the flask was empty.
Mateo's dog has learned to open the garden gate. The latch needs a second catch.
Cold noodles: sesame paste, soy sauce, lime, cucumber. Loosen the sauce with a little cooking water.
The library has a repair event next month. Bring the lamp with the unreliable switch.
Tenía ganas de cancelar la cena, pero ver a Inés me vino bien. Llegué a casa más tranquila.
Keep a spare pair of reading glasses in the sewing box. Threading needles shouldn't become an expedition.
The council's collection calendar changed. Put the new dates into the phone before another missed recycling week.
Made an emergency folder with policy numbers and useful contacts. Tell Nora where it is.
My niece asked whether clouds are heavy. Look it up together next time instead of guessing.
Comprar harina de fuerza para el pan. La bolsa casi vacía del armario es harina de repostería.
Brought leftover stew for lunch at work. It tasted better than the ambitious dinner it started as.
A good year for ordinary things: regular walks, fewer lost keys, friends who stayed for washing up.
The shower pressure improved after cleaning the head. Remember this before assuming something expensive is broken.
Booked a weekend drawing class. Bring soft pencils, an eraser, and the courage to draw badly in public.
La revisión de la vista salió bien. Pedir una copia de la graduación para guardarla con las facturas.
Dad's tomato labels washed clean in the rain. Use pencil or waterproof ink next year.
A work task kept circling in my head during dinner. Writing tomorrow's first step down helped me let it go.
For the long train ride: downloaded audiobook, water, charger, something crunchy, a layer warmer than seems necessary.
Walked through the old neighborhood. The bakery is now a flower shop, but the doorstep still slopes.
El melón estaba perfecto. Guardar las semillas no significa que tenga sitio para plantar melones.
The new budget needs a category for gifts. Birthdays are predictable even when I act surprised.
Try recording Grandma telling the story about the runaway donkey. Ask her first, and use a quiet room.
Stopped at the pool after work. Only swam for twenty minutes, which was enough to loosen my shoulders.
The novel got better once I stopped trying to remember every distant relative. Trust the story a little.
Cambiar la goma de la ventana antes del frío. Medir el ancho del hueco y llevar una muestra.
Nora said, 'You don't have to turn every interest into a project.' Relevant to the three new notebooks.
Order extra photo prints for Mum. She wants actual pictures for the hallway, not another shared album link.
Pear crumble works with oats in the topping. Less sugar next time; the fruit was already very sweet.
Put the work notebook away for the holiday. Found the crossword underneath and finally finished the bottom corner.
Revisar los cargos pequeños de la tarjeta. Creo que sigo pagando una aplicación que ya no uso.
The clinic changed my appointment to the 14th. Update the paper calendar as well as the phone.
Started a jar for spare buttons. This feels suspiciously like becoming my mother.
Weekend plan: sharpen garden shears, plant parsley, call Hugo, leave space for doing nothing.
Sara's daughter read a whole page aloud to me. We celebrated with strawberries and a second page.
Compré cerezas al salir del trabajo. La mitad desapareció antes de llegar a casa.
Booked the smaller guesthouse near the station. Check whether late arrival needs a door code.
The lake was too cold for a long swim. Went in anyway. Came out laughing. Tea tasted exceptional afterward.
Keep the little screwdriver with the sewing kit. It's the right size for tightening my glasses.
Roasted tomatoes froze well in flat bags. Make another batch while they're inexpensive.
El club de lectura eligió un libro larguísimo. Empezar ahora, no tres noches antes.
Finished work early enough to catch the hardware shop. Replacement cupboard handle is finally the correct size.
Compare savings rates this weekend. The introductory rate ended and I didn't notice.
Try a short stretch before bed. My shoulders have been creeping toward my ears again.
Found a handwritten dedication in a used poetry book. Bought it partly because someone once loved it.
Para la cena: sopa primero, pescado al horno y fruta. No hace falta preparar cinco acompañamientos.
Dad fell asleep during the film and woke up insisting he understood the ending. Nobody challenged him.
Rain soaked my trousers on the way to work. Leave a spare pair of socks in the bag at least.
The fridge door seal needs cleaning, not replacing. Warm soapy water sorted the sticking corner.
Nora and I booked a beginner dance class. Wear shoes that slide a little and bring water.
La planta que parecía muerta tiene dos brotes nuevos. No tirar las macetas tan pronto.
Passport still valid, travel insurance renewed, boarding pass downloaded. Check the airport bus schedule tomorrow.
The tiny café near the harbor served beans with lemon and dill. Try recreating them at home.
A work meeting was canceled, leaving enough time for a proper lunch. Ate outside and watched the sparrows.
My nephew wants to learn chess. Start with a few pieces rather than explaining every rule at once.
Llevar el ventilador al taller de reparación del barrio. Hace ruido, pero todavía gira bien.
Audiobooks make folding laundry much less tedious. Keep one light novel just for chores.
The dentist recommends replacing the worn brush head. Put the replacement date on the calendar.
Idea for a family present: a small cookbook with one recipe and one story from each household.
Walked home from work with no headphones. Heard geese overhead before I saw them.
La factura de la reparación está en la carpeta de la casa. Guardar también la garantía de la pieza.
Borrowed a board game from Mateo. Count the pieces before returning it; one blue token rolled under the sofa.
Made orange peel candy. It took ages. The kitchen smelled wonderful. Give away half before I eat it all.
This year's favorite photo is blurry: everyone laughing while Mum tries to set the timer.
Sort the drawer of charging cables. Keep the ones I can identify and find the local electronics recycling point.
Después del trabajo pasé a ver a papá. Arreglamos una lámpara y hablamos de todo menos de la lámpara.
The balcony gets direct sun earlier than I remembered. Move the mint before it dries out again.
Booked a checkup for the 19th. Write down the questions beforehand so I don't remember them on the bus home.
Inés lent me a book of short stories for the journey. Return it with the recipe she asked for.
Bought train tickets for the family visit. The earlier return leaves time to unpack before bedtime.
La ensalada de patata salió mejor aliñándola todavía templada. Añadir las hierbas cuando se enfríe.
After work, finally hung the framed photograph that's been leaning against the wall since spring. The room feels finished.
Annual budget check: allow more for train fares and less for clothes. The wardrobe is already doing its job.
Hugo brought a box of family photos. Write names on the backs while he can still identify everyone.
The first cold evening made me want lentil soup and an old film. Both were excellent decisions.
Mañana, al salir del trabajo: recoger las botas, comprar pan y llamar a Nora. Si queda luz, dar una vuelta por el parque.
